'''Reid Gandon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as an agent for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he was working to identify the [[Justicars' Brigade]]'s supplier. He believed the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] was helping them, but needed proof. He tasked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to download manifest data from work stations around the Justicars' [[Shipping Docks]].<ref name="TOR" />
